metadata.description: SlotVFX plugins for Claude Code: create, animate, test and export slot game VFX in SlotVFX Desktop.

plugins.name: slotvfx
plugins.description: Claude Code plugin for SlotVFX on macOS: 20 skills plus the SlotVFX Desktop MCP connection, so Claude can create, animate, test and export slot game VFX (win celebrations, transitions, particles, Spine) right in the editor.

plugins.name: slotvfx-windows
plugins.description: Windows version of the SlotVFX plugin for Claude Code: 20 skills plus the SlotVFX Desktop MCP connection, using the Node.js built into SlotVFX.
